sequences.title: Place an order
sequences.summary: A dispatcher submits an order. The API verifies the token, reserves stock line by line, writes order, lines and shipment in one transaction, and queues the label job.

steps.t: INSERT orders, order_lines, shipments, parcels · COMMIT

steps.d: After commit, so a rolled-back order never queues a label.

steps.t: Stock is reserved in the same transaction as the order; a 401 or 409 reserves nothing.

sequences.title: Rate quote
sequences.summary: The quote panel asks for rates. A cached answer is returned for ten minutes; otherwise every active carrier is asked in turn.

steps.d: Through the gateway and the token guard (see Place an order).

steps.t: each active carrier, one after another
On a miss, quote latency is the sum of every carrier's response time.

sequences.title: Label generation via the queue
sequences.summary: A queued job buys one label per parcel from the carrier, stores each PDF in object storage and records the key on the parcel.

steps.d: Relabel requests take this path too.

steps.t: The HTTP response does not wait for the label.
A retry starts the loop again from the first parcel.

sequences.title: Carrier webhook tracking update
sequences.summary: Carriers post batches of tracking events. The API maps each event onto a parcel and records it; the tracking board picks the change up on its next poll.

steps.t: Nothing is pushed to the browser; the board sees the update on its next poll.

sequences.title: Nightly analytics refresh
sequences.summary: At 02:00 UTC the worker rebuilds the reporting views in the analytics file from a read-only snapshot of the operational DB.

steps.t: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW daily_shipment_volume, carrier_on_time_rate
a report request arrives during the rebuild
The worker writes the same analytics file that the API reads.

sequences.title: Sign in
sequences.summary: The console signs the user in with the OIDC authorization code flow and PKCE; the API verifies each bearer token against the provider's published keys.

steps.t: Tokens are held in memory only.
first /v1 call with a bearer token
JWKS not cached, or key id unknown

sequences.title: Build and deploy
sequences.summary: A version tag runs the tests, pushes both images to the registry and rolls out a new revision of the API and the worker.

steps.t: The run stops; nothing is pushed.
Migrations run when the API starts, before the worker restarts.
